title: Correction Slip
summary: This Order makes changes to electoral arrangements for the borough of the Wirral (“the Borough”) following recommendations made by the Local Government Boundary Commission for England. The area of the Borough remains unchanged.

title: Correction Slip

title: The Social Security (Income and Capital Disregards) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulations 2 to 6 amend respectively the State Pension Credit Regulations 2002 (S.I. 2002/1792), the Housing Benefit Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/213), the Housing Benefit (Persons who have attained the qualifying age for state pension credit) Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/214), the Employment and Support Allowance Regulations 2008 (S.I. 2008/794), and the Universal Credit Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/376).

title: Northern Ireland Fiscal Council Act (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: An Act to make provision for the establishment and functions of the Northern Ireland Fiscal Council; and for connected purposes.

title: The Housing (Scotland) Act 2025 (Commencement No. 4 and Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force a number of the provisions of the Housing (Scotland) Act 2025 (“the Act”) on 9 November 2026, 1 April 2027 and 1 August 2027.

title: The Armed Forces (Service Complaints Miscellaneous Provisions) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Armed Forces (Service Complaints Miscellaneous Provisions) Regulations 2015 (S.I. 2015/2064) (“the 2015 Regulations”).

title: The Armed Forces Commissioner Act 2025 (Commencement No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These are the second commencement Regulations made under the Armed Forces Commissioner Act 2025 (c. 23) (“the 2025 Act”).

title: The Social Security (Further Methods of Recovery) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in relation to the recovery of debt under Schedules 3ZA and 3ZB to the Social Security Administration Act 1992 (c. 5) (“the Act”), as inserted by the Public Authorities (Fraud, Error and Recovery) Act 2025 (c. 28) (“2025 Act”).

title: Inquiry (Mother and Baby Institutions, Magdalene Laundries and Workhouses) and Redress Scheme Act (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: An Act to make provision relating to a Truth Recovery Public Inquiry into Mother and Baby Institutions, Magdalene Laundries and Workhouses between 1922 and 1995; to establish the Truth Recovery Redress Service and to enable payments to be made to or in respect of certain persons; and for connected purposes.

title: The Social Security (Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to the Social Security (Recovery of Benefits) Regulations 1997 (S.I. 1997/2205), the State Pension Credit Regulations 2002 (S.I. 2002/1792), the Housing Benefit Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/213), the Housing Benefit (Persons who have attained the qualifying age for state pension credit) Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/214), the Employment and Support Allowance Regulations 2008 (S.I. 2008/794), the Social Security (Recovery of Benefits) (Lump Sum Payments) Regulations 2008 (S.I. 2008/1596), the Universal Credit Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/376), the Social Security (Overpayments and Recovery) Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/384), the Personal Independence Payment (Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/387) (“the PIP Transitional Regulations”), the Universal Credit (Transitional Provisions) Regulations 2014 (S.I. 2014/1230) and the Universal Credit, Personal Independence Payment and Employment and Support Allowance (Amendment) Regulations 2026 (S.I. 2026/395).
